# ODST Group

> ODST Group provides luxury hospitality, chartered aviation, and comprehensive Hajj & Umrah pilgrimage travel services connecting Indonesia and Saudi Arabia.

ODST Group operates three core integrated business divisions: ODST Hotels (premier accommodations in Makkah & Madinah), ODST Airlines (private aviation & flight charters), and ODST Tour & Travel (guided pilgrimage spiritual packages).

## Services

- [ODST Hotels](https://odst.id/): Five-star premium hotels and accommodation in Makkah and Madinah tailored for pilgrimage comfort.
- [ODST Airlines](https://odst.id/): Private flight charters and aviation logistics between Indonesia and Saudi Arabia.
- [ODST Tour & Travel](https://odst.id/): End-to-end Umrah & Hajj packages, guided spiritual journeys, visa handling, and ground logistics.
